CODE_NOT_IN_STARTER_SET: For that procedure our office will call you back with exact pricing. I can still help schedule or answer general questions.
cannot_determine: I don't have enough benefit detail to quote an exact amount right now. Our front desk can confirm your copay when you arrive or call you back shortly.
PAYER_NOT_SEEDED: I don't have your insurance plan on file yet. Our front desk will verify your benefits and call you back with your copay.
PAYER_CLASS_MISMATCH: That looks like a medical plan ID. For dental benefits I'll need your dental insurance card, or our team can verify at the front desk.
PROVIDER_LOCATION_DEFER: I can book your visit, but copay amounts can vary by provider and location. Our front desk will confirm your exact copay before your appointment.
CODING_REVIEW_REQUIRED: A clinical reviewer needs to confirm the procedure codes before we can verify insurance. Our team will follow up shortly.
